family.description: R1 is a gene for resistance to late blight, the most destructive disease in potato cultivation worldwide. The R1 gene belongs to the class of plant genes for pathogen resistance that have a leucine zipper motif, a putative nucleotide binding domain and a leucine-rich repeat domain [[cite:PUB00053797]]. This protein is found associated with [pfam:PF00931].
family.name: Late blight resistance protein R1
